summary: Rewrote the makefiles (generated version.h/ops.h rules, dependency tracking, config stamp, link order, correct check/install per BUILDING.md), removed the stale hand-written include/qs/ops.h, and fixed all -Wall -Wextra warnings in release and debug builds, including the unary minus precedence, size-parse overflow and size_t formatting issues. Verified clean-tree builds at -j1/8/32 for every target, make check, install staging, DEBUG=1 and incremental rebuilds.
